description: This file provides an enhanced version of the regcomp function, specifically modifying compilation flags to include REG_ENHANCED when REG_EXTENDED is not set, and then delegating to the standard regcomp function.

methods.name: int git_regcomp(regex_t * preg,const char * pattern,int cflags)
methods.description: A wrapper around the standard regcomp function that enforces enhanced regular expression support by setting REG_ENHANCED when REG_EXTENDED is not specified.
